name: summary-counts-use-filtered-sets
description: The Summary counts must come from the filtered sets, not the naive search results — reviews filtered by in-range submitted_at, and PRs filtered by the merge-date fallback. Over-counting here inflates the whole review.
prompt:
Do NOT call any tools. For my weekly review 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-07 the raw
research came back like this:

- `gh search prs --reviewed-by=@me --updated=` returned 29 candidate PRs, but
  after checking each PR's reviews only 6 had a review I submitted inside the
  range. 1 of those 6 had inline comments from me.
- `gh search prs --author=@me --merged-at=` returned 11 PRs, but confirming
  `merged_at` per PR via the API showed only 7 actually merged inside the range —
  the other 4 merged the following week.

Write the `## Summary` block work bullets and state which numbers you used.

assertions.description: never reports the naive candidate count as reviews
reports the with-comments subset from the filtered set
